svg.text: LangGraph is used where a run pauses for a person, loops or runs steps in parallel. CV claim check (F8) and interview quality (F10) are plain Python.
Picks a tool, reads the result, picks again (max 16 steps).
RAG draft, code check, at most one revision.
Pauses until a person clicks Yes or No.
Reads and scores the CV; pauses for include / exclude.
Nothing is sent until a person clicks Send.
Six graders in parallel, then the scorecard.
Four steps in parallel; repair at most twice.
One retry, then the standard text.
Dashed lines: purple = loop back · grey = skip ahead · red = to failed · blue = resumed run
needs review / AI could not score
pause: run stops until a click
